name: protein kinase C alpha
pathways: positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction

function.text: PRKCA encodes protein kinase C alpha type. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and calcium,diacylglycerol-dependent serine/threonine kinase activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.
